definition_zh: 手艺；工匠技艺；做工的精良程度
definition_en: the skill and care that a person brings to making something by hand, or the quality that such work shows
core_image: 一双布满刻痕的手把木料刨成严丝合缝的榫卯，桌角没有一颗钉子
scene: 老作坊的木门半开，刨花铺了一地，师傅用手掌摸过桌面确认平滑。The craftsmanship in the walnut table shows in the joints, which meet without a single nail.
sceneCN: 这里 craftsmanship 指「手工制作中以训练与专注形成的技艺」（第 1 个义项：作为制作者的能力与用心）；句意为这张胡桃木桌的手艺体现在接缝处，不用一颗钉子却严丝合缝。

pos.zh: 手艺；工匠技艺；做工（不可数，一般不用复数）

derivatives.zh: craft（技艺）+ man（人）→ 手艺人；匠人
craft + -s + woman → 女匠人（语义偏移：标明性别）
古英语 cræft（力量、技艺）→ 技艺；行业；精心制作
craft 的旧义「技艺」+ -y（属性）→ 狡猾的（语义偏移：技艺用于算计）
craft + work → 手工制品（语义偏移：从能力转指成品）
craft + -s + person → 匠人（中性称谓）

senses.title: Skill and care in handwork
senses.titleCN: 手工制作中投入的技艺与用心
senses.definition: the trained ability and attentiveness that a person brings to making something by hand
senses.definitionCN: 人在手工制作中投入的熟练能力与专注
senses.example: The craftsmanship in the walnut table shows in the joints, which meet without a single nail.
senses.exampleCN: 这张胡桃木桌的手艺体现在接缝处，不用一颗钉子却严丝合缝。
senses.why: The noun joins craft 'skill', -man 'person' and -ship 'condition', so it names the trained state of a maker before it names any object.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 craft「技艺」、-man「人」与 -ship「状态」构成，因而先指制作者受训的状态，再指物件。

senses.title: Quality visible in a finished piece
senses.titleCN: 成品经细看显露的做工水平
senses.definition: the level of skill that a finished object reveals to anyone who examines it closely
senses.definitionCN: 成品经仔细查看后显露出的技艺水平
senses.example: Buyers pay extra for the craftsmanship of a hand-stitched briefcase.
senses.exampleCN: 买家愿意为手工缝制公文包的做工多付钱。
senses.why: Once the maker's trained state is judged through the object, the same noun shifts from the person to the thing.
senses.whyCN: 一旦通过物件来评判制作者的状态，同一个名词就从人转到物。

senses.title: Traditional technique of one trade
senses.titleCN: 某一行业世代相传的成套技法
senses.definition: the inherited body of methods that belongs to a single craft, such as joinery, lacquer work or pottery
senses.definitionCN: 属于单一行业的传承方法体系，如木工、漆作或制陶
senses.example: Japanese lacquer craftsmanship has been passed down through family workshops for centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 日本的漆器工艺由家族作坊世代相传了数百年。
senses.why: A trade counts as a craft in the older sense, so the standard of its practice is spoken of as a tradition rather than as one person's skill.
senses.whyCN: 行业本就属于旧义的 craft，因此其做法水准被说成一项传统，而不只是某个人的手艺。

senses.title: Fine execution in film or model making
senses.titleCN: 影视与模型制作中的精细执行
senses.definition: careful, detailed execution applied to constructed works such as films, miniatures or games
senses.definitionCN: 在电影、微缩模型或游戏等制作物上展现的精细执行
senses.example: Critics praised the craftsmanship of the miniature sets, built at true scale.
senses.exampleCN: 评论界称赞那些按真实比例搭起的微缩布景的制作功力。
senses.why: A single hand is replaced by a workshop of specialists, but the question asked is still how well the thing was made.
senses.whyCN: 单手被一整组专业人员替代，但追问的仍是这件东西做得多好。

senses.title: Ethos of doing work well
senses.definition: the value placed on unhurried, honest and complete work as a way of living
senses.definitionCN: 把不赶工、不取巧、做完整当作生活方式的价值观
senses.example: He speaks of craftsmanship as a promise to the person who will use the chair.
senses.exampleCN: 他把工匠精神说成是对将来使用这把椅子的人的一份承诺。
senses.why: When skill is treated as a standard rather than a technique, the noun becomes a word about how one ought to work.
senses.whyCN: 当技艺被当作标准而非手段，这个词就变成关于人应当如何工作的词。

senses.title: Careful building of something abstract
senses.titleCN: 对抽象之物的刻意构建
senses.definition: deliberate, well-fitted construction of an argument, a treaty, a policy or a piece of writing
senses.definitionCN: 对论证、条约、政策或文章所作的刻意而严整的构建
senses.example: The treaty shows the craftsmanship of lawyers who left nothing to accident.
senses.exampleCN: 这份条约显出律师们的手笔，没有一处是碰巧留下的。
senses.why: Joints that fit without nails are a model for clauses that fit without contradiction.
senses.whyCN: 不用钉子也严丝合缝的接缝，正是不靠矛盾也能咬合的条款的模型。

senses.title: Skill handed on at the bench
senses.titleCN: 在工作台前传下去的技艺
senses.definition: the way a craft is learned by working beside an experienced maker rather than by reading
senses.definitionCN: 在有经验的制作者身边做工而习得技艺的方式，而非靠阅读
senses.example: Craftsmanship survives where apprentices still spend years at the bench.
senses.exampleCN: 只要学徒还在工作台前待上数年，手艺就能延续。
senses.why: The suffix marks a lasting condition, and a condition held over years is exactly what apprenticeship produces.
senses.whyCN: 这个话题后缀标记一种持久状态，而经年累月保持的状态正是学徒制所造就的。

senses.title: Traces that prove a hand made it
senses.titleCN: 能证明出自人手的痕迹
senses.definition: the small irregularities and tool marks by which handwork can be told apart from machine output
senses.definitionCN: 可据以把手工作品与机器产品区分开来的细微不均匀与工具痕迹
senses.example: Collectors look for slight unevenness in the glaze as evidence of craftsmanship.
senses.exampleCN: 藏家会寻找釉面上轻微的不匀，以此作为手工制作的证据。
senses.why: Perfect uniformity can be stamped out by a machine, so slight imperfection becomes the visible signature of a person.
senses.whyCN: 完全的均一可以由机器压印出来，于是轻微的不完美反而成了人的可见签名。

intro.en: Craftsmanship is a native English compound of three Old English pieces, so its history is the history of those pieces rather than of a borrowed word.
intro.cn: craftsmanship 是由三个古英语成分构成的本族复合词，因此它的历史就是这三个成分的历史，而不是一个借词的历史。

items.en: Cræft meant 'power, strength, skill, art' and covered both the strength of a body and the trained skill of a hand; it is the word that survives as craft.
items.cn: cræft 意为「力量、气力、技艺、手艺」，同时涵盖身体的力气与手上训练出的技艺；这个词后来写作 craft。

items.en: The Old English noun is generally traced to a Germanic noun reconstructed as *kraftiz 'power, force'; the reconstruction is secure at the Germanic level and reaches no further back with confidence.
items.cn: 这个古英语名词一般追溯到重构为 *kraftiz「力量、气力」的日耳曼语名词；该重构在日耳曼语层面可靠，再往前则无把握。

items.en: Man 'person' formed compounds such as cræftman 'one who works at a craft', the ancestor of craftsman.
items.cn: man「人」构成 cræftman「从事某门技艺的人」这类复合词，是 craftsman 的前身。

items.en: The suffix -scipe 'state, condition, quality' produced nouns such as freondscipe 'friendship'; it is the -ship of craftsmanship.
items.cn: 后缀 -scipe「状态、情形、性质」构成 freondscipe「友谊」这类名词，它就是 craftsmanship 中的 -ship。

items.en: Forms such as craftship and craftsman appear in Middle English, still naming the standing of a skilled worker rather than the quality of an object.
items.cn: craftship 与 craftsman 这类形式见于中古英语，仍指熟练工人的身份地位，而不是物件的品质。

items.en: By the seventeenth century craftsmanship is used for the quality of the work itself; this object-directed sense is the later development.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，craftsmanship 已用于指作品本身的品质；这个指向物件的义项是后来才发展出来的。

note.en: The first group holds words that share the shape or the stem and are regularly confused; the second holds words that come close in meaning without sharing the history.
note.cn: 第一组是同形或同词干、常被混淆的词；第二组是意思相近但来历不同的词。

entries.definition: The shorter noun behind the compound; it names the skill itself or, separately, a small boat or an aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 构成该复合词的短名词，本身指技艺，另有小船与飞行器之义。

entries.definition: Built on the same cræft but with -y, it means cunning: skill used to get one's way rather than to make well.
entries.definitionCN: 同出 cræft 加 -y，意为狡猾：技艺用于取巧而非做好东西。

entries.definition: A near neighbour that builds the idea on hand plus craft; it names the activity or the product, not the maker's standing.
entries.definitionCN: 近邻词，用 hand 加 craft 构成；它指活动或产品，不指制作者的身份。

entries.definition: Craft plus work, pointing at the things produced rather than at the quality they show.
entries.definitionCN: craft 加 work，指做出来的物件，而不指这些物件显露的品质。

entries.definition: The closest synonym; it judges the standard reached in a piece of work and is neutral about whether the work is manual.
entries.definitionCN: 最接近的同义词，评判一件工作的水准，且不限定是否为手工。

entries.definition: Skill viewed as art, stressing imagination and personal style where craftsmanship stresses trained method.
entries.definitionCN: 把技艺看作艺术，强调想象与个人风格，而 craftsmanship 强调受训的方法。

entries.definition: The plain, general noun for trained ability of any kind; craftsmanship adds the hand, the material and the standard.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何受训能力的普通名词；craftsmanship 另带手工、材料与标准之义。

entries.definition: A particular way of doing a step well; it is a countable method, while craftsmanship is an uncountable standard.
entries.definitionCN: 把某一步骤做好的具体方法；technique 可数，craftsmanship 则是不可数的标准。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: craft 'skill' + man 'person' + -ship 'state': the standing of being a person of skill.
normal.cn: craft「技艺」+ man「人」+ -ship「状态」：身为一个有技艺之人的状态。

normal.en: The family runs craftsman, craftswoman, craftsperson, craftsmanship, and the parallel statesmanship and sportsmanship.
normal.cn: 同族词有 craftsman、craftswoman、craftsperson、craftsmanship，以及同型的 statesmanship 与 sportsmanship。

normal.en: Fixed phrases carry the judgement: exquisite craftsmanship, traditional craftsmanship, superb craftsmanship.
normal.cn: 固定搭配承载评价：精湛的手艺、传统工艺、一流的做工。

normal.en: The same Old English cræft also gives craft and crafty, where skill quietly turns into cunning.
normal.cn: 同一个古英语 cræft 还给出 craft 与 crafty，技艺在那里悄悄变成算计。

normal.en: Learning is usually described through apprenticeship: to serve an apprenticeship at the bench.
normal.cn: 学习过程常用学徒制描述：在工作台前当学徒。

abstract.en: Picture a joint so tight that the two boards seem to have grown together.
abstract.cn: 想象一处接缝紧到两块板像是自己长在了一起。

abstract.en: Picture a fingerprint left in wet clay, proof that a person and not a press was there.
abstract.cn: 想象湿泥上留下的一枚指纹，证明在场的是人而不是压机。

abstract.en: Picture a chair still level after eighty years, quietly reporting how it was made.
abstract.cn: 想象一把八十年后仍然平稳的椅子，安静地报告它当初是怎么做成的。

examples.en: The violin's craftsmanship is visible in the purfling, cut by hand and never quite identical on both sides.
examples.cn: 这把小提琴的手艺体现在镶边，手工刻出，两侧从不完全一致。

examples.en: Visitors come to the island mainly for the boatyard's craftsmanship.
examples.cn: 游客来这座岛，主要是为了看船厂的手艺。

examples.en: Her craftsmanship as an editor lies in cuts the reader never notices.
examples.cn: 她作为编辑的功力，在于读者从未察觉的那些删削。

dict_mnemonic.text: craft（技艺）+ man（人）+ ship（状态）＝ 手艺人身上的那种状态；摸一处接缝就能想起它。

root: 古英语 cræft「力量、技艺」+ man「人」+ -scipe「状态、性质」；cræft 一般追溯到日耳曼语 *kraftiz「力量」，更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line: a trained hand works a material, the result is judged, the method belongs to a trade, and the noun then reaches films, ethics, arguments, teaching and the marks left behind.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条线展开：受训的手加工材料，成品被评判，方法属于某个行业，随后这个词延伸到影视、伦理、论证、传授与留下的痕迹。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that has repeated one motion ten thousand times, leaving a joint no machine would make.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只把同一个动作重复过上万次的手，留下一处机器做不出的接缝。

branches.en: CONDITION AND EVIDENCE: first the maker's trained state, then the same quality read off the finished piece.
branches.cn: 状态与证据：先是制作者受训的状态，再是从成品上读出的同一品质。

branches.en: A TRADE HANDED ON: the method belongs to a craft, and the craft lives only while it is taught at the bench.
branches.cn: 行业相传：方法属于某门技艺，而技艺只有靠工作台前的传授才活着。

branches.en: BEYOND THE HAND: sets, treaties and essays are made too, so the noun moves to film work and to careful argument.
branches.cn: 超出双手：布景、条约与文章也是被做出来的，于是这个词延伸到影视制作与严谨论证。

branches.en: WORK AS A VALUE: skill raised to a standard turns the noun into a word about how one ought to work.
branches.cn: 做工即价值：技艺升为标准，这个词便转为关于人应当如何工作的词。

branches.en: THE HAND'S FINGERPRINT: what a machine cannot fake is the slight unevenness that marks a person's presence.
branches.cn: 手的指纹：机器伪造不出的，正是标记着人在场的细微不匀。

intro.en: All three parts of the word are native material, and each still works on its own in modern English, so the compound can be read piece by piece.
intro.cn: 这个词的三个部分都是本族材料，每一部分在现代英语中仍能独立使用，因此整个复合词可以逐块读出。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source behind this word: the stem and both suffixes are Germanic. The parallel forms statesmanship and sportsmanship are English formations built on the same pattern, not Latin borrowings.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词背后没有拉丁来源：词干与两个后缀都属日耳曼语。statesmanship 与 sportsmanship 这类同型词是按同一模式构成的英语形式，并非拉丁借词。

items.example: The stem carries both the strength and the skill.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干同时带着力气与技艺。

items.structure: man (Old English noun used in compounds, 'person')
items.example: The second element names the person, not the sex.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分标出的是人，而非性别。

items.example: The suffix turns a person into a standing or a quality.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把人变成一种身份或一种品质。

items.example: The compound is recorded from the Middle English period.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词从中古英语时期就有记录。

items.example: The form marks sex without changing the craft sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个形式只标出性别，不改变技艺之义。

items.meaning: a maker named without marking sex
items.example: The neutral form names the maker without marking sex.
items.exampleCN: 这个中性形式只称制作者，不标性别。

items.structure: -manship (productive English suffix on the model of -ship)
items.meaning: skill in a role or activity
items.meaningCN: 在某种角色或活动中的本领
items.example: The suffix spread from craftsman to statesman and sportsman.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀从 craftsman 扩散到 statesman 与 sportsman。

items.example: Here the suffix judges conduct rather than objects.
items.exampleCN: 这里后缀评判的是行事，而不是物件。

items.meaningCN: 体育运动中的公正风度
items.example: The word shifted from skill to conduct.
items.exampleCN: 这个词从技艺偏移到了品行。

items.example: A parallel compound builds the idea on hand instead of on the maker.
items.exampleCN: 一个平行复合词把这一观念建在「手」上，而不是建在制作者上。
