items.exampleCN: 这个装置因它所计的收费而得名。

definition_zh: 贡品；贡赋；敬意；悼词；颂词；（矿业）矿产分成
definition_en: a payment by one ruler or state to another as a sign of submission, or an expression of respect and admiration
core_image: 石阶下的一只木箱被打开，里面是金片与香料，抬箱的人低着头
scene: 王座前的石阶上，远方来使跪献一箱黄金与香料，作为臣服的表示。The province sent tribute every spring to the capital.
sceneCN: 这里 tribute 指「属地向宗主定期缴纳的贡赋」（第 1 个义项：作为臣服的财物缴纳）；句意为该省每年春天向都城进贡。

pos.zh: 贡品；贡赋；敬意；颂词（可数或不可数）

derivatives.zh: tribute + -ary（属于…的）→ 支流；进贡的（语义偏移：向大河「进贡」的小河）
con-（共同）+ tribuere（分配）→ 贡献（同根，语义偏移：共同给出）
contribute + -ion（动作）→ 贡献；捐款
contribute + -or（施动者）→ 贡献者；投稿人
dis-（分开）+ tribuere → 分发（同根，语义偏移：分开给出）
ad-（向）+ tribuere → 归因于；属性（同根，语义偏移：把某物归到某人名下）

senses.title: Payment by a subject state to a ruler
senses.titleCN: 属国向宗主缴纳的贡赋
senses.definition: a regular payment of goods or money by one state or people to a stronger one as an acknowledgment of dependence
senses.definitionCN: 一国或一族向更强者定期缴纳货物或钱财，以承认依附关系
senses.example: The province sent tribute every spring to the capital.
senses.exampleCN: 该省每年春天向都城进贡。
senses.why: Latin tributum was a thing contributed, from tribuere 'to allot', and the word starts as what is handed over on command.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 tributum 是被献出之物，出自 tribuere「分配」，因此这个词起初就是奉命交出之物。

senses.title: An offering expressing respect
senses.definition: a gift or act offered to show honour, gratitude or admiration
senses.definitionCN: 为表尊敬、感激或钦佩而献出的礼物或行为
senses.example: The village laid flowers as a tribute to the doctor who stayed.
senses.exampleCN: 村民献上鲜花，向留下来的那位医生致敬。
senses.why: What is given to a ruler under compulsion becomes, in free use, what is given to anyone out of respect.
senses.whyCN: 在强制之下交给统治者的东西，在自由的用法里就成了出于敬意交给任何人的东西。

senses.title: Evidence of a quality's worth
senses.definition: a visible proof of the excellence of something, as a tribute to a design or a method
senses.definitionCN: 某物之优良的可见证据，如对某种设计或方法的称许
senses.example: The bridge's survival is a tribute to the engineer who built it.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥得以存留，就是那位工程师的功劳证明。
senses.why: Praise is paid like a due, so an outcome that honours a maker is spoken of as a payment.
senses.whyCN: 赞誉像应缴之物一样被付出，因此为制作者增光的结果被说成一笔缴纳。

senses.title: A speech or ceremony in honour
senses.definition: a formal expression of praise, such as a eulogy, a memorial speech or a concert in someone's honour
senses.definitionCN: 正式的颂扬表达，如悼词、纪念演说或为某人举办的音乐会
senses.example: The concert was a tribute to the composer, not a performance of his music.
senses.exampleCN: 这场音乐会是对那位作曲家的致敬，并非演奏他的作品。
senses.why: A ceremony is the organised form of the offering, and the countable noun names the occasion.
senses.whyCN: 仪式是献礼的组织化形式，可数名词便指这一场合。

senses.title: Forced labour or goods exacted
senses.definition: historical: labour, produce or service exacted by a ruler or a landlord
senses.definitionCN: 历史用法：统治者或地主强征的劳役、产物或服务
senses.example: Ten days of tribute labour were owed to the lord each harvest.
senses.exampleCN: 每次收获，都要向领主服十天贡役。
senses.why: Where money is scarce, the same obligation is paid in work, and the noun covers the labour as well.
senses.whyCN: 在缺钱之处，同一种义务以劳动支付，而这个名词也涵盖劳动。

senses.title: A share of ore paid to the landowner
senses.definition: mining: a portion of ore or of its value paid to the owner of the ground as a condition of working it
senses.definitionCN: 矿业用法：作为开采条件付给地表所有者的一部分矿石或其价值
senses.example: The miners kept seven parts and gave one as tribute.
senses.exampleCN: 矿工留下七份，把一份作为矿产分成交出。
senses.why: The old duty on produce survives in one technical trade, attached to the ground rather than to a state.
senses.whyCN: 旧时对产物的义务在一个技术性行业中留存，付给土地而非国家。

senses.title: A levy in older English usage
senses.definition: archaic: a tax or levy imposed by a ruler or a town
senses.definitionCN: 古旧用法：由统治者或城镇课征的税或摊派
senses.example: The chronicle lists the tribute laid on each ward.
senses.exampleCN: 编年史记下了对每个街区摊派的款项。
senses.why: Before tax became the general word, tribute covered any exaction, and the older sense remains in historical writing.
senses.whyCN: 在 tax 成为通称之前，tribute 涵盖一切强征，这一旧义留在历史写作中。

senses.title: A tribute band or tribute act
senses.definition: a modern compound use for performers who imitate a famous artist as a form of homage
senses.definitionCN: 现代复合用法：以模仿某位名家来示敬的表演者
senses.example: The tribute band plays the same three albums note for note.
senses.exampleCN: 这支致敬乐队一个音不差地演奏那三张专辑。
senses.why: Imitation offered as honour is the same structure as goods offered to a superior, with admiration as the ruler.
senses.whyCN: 作为敬意献上的模仿，与献给尊长的货物是同一结构，只是把钦佩当作了尊者。

intro.en: Tribute comes from a Latin word for a thing assigned and handed over, and the same verb behind it builds contribute, distribute and attribute.
intro.cn: tribute 来自一个指「被分配并交出之物」的拉丁词，其背后的同一个动词还构成 contribute、distribute 与 attribute。

items.en: Tribus meant a tribe or a division of the Roman people, the unit through which taxes and duties were assigned. Its own origin is uncertain; a link to tri- 'three' is sometimes proposed but not demonstrated.
items.cn: tribus 指部族或罗马人民的划分单位，税赋正是通过这一单位摊派。它自身的来源不确定；有人提出与 tri-「三」的联系，但未得到证实。

items.en: Tribuere meant 'to allot, assign, grant, pay'. The verb starts from dividing among groups and ends by meaning to hand over what is owed.
items.cn: tribuere 意为「分配、指派、给予、支付」。这个动词从在群体间划分开始，最终指交出所欠之物。

items.en: Tributum was the thing contributed, a payment laid on a people; the neuter participle became a noun of the payment itself.
items.cn: tributum 是被献出之物，即摊在民众身上的缴纳；这个中性分词成了指缴纳本身的名词。

items.en: Old French tribut carries the payment sense into English, where it keeps the tone of obligation rather than of gift.
items.cn: 古法语 tribut 把缴纳义带入英语，在英语中保留了义务而非赠礼的语气。

items.en: The sense of an expression of respect develops in the sixteenth century, when praise is spoken of as something owed and paid.
items.cn: 表敬意的义项在十六世纪发展出来，当时赞誉被说成欠下并偿付之物。

items.en: Mining keeps the oldest sense as a share of ore for the landowner, while concert billing gives tribute a new life as an act of imitation offered in homage.
items.cn: 矿业把最古老的义项保留为付给地主的矿石分成，而演出海报又让 tribute 以「以模仿示敬」的方式获得新生。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin verb and is constantly confused; the second holds words for payments, praise and homage.
note.cn: 第一组共享那个拉丁动词，极易混淆；第二组是缴纳、赞誉与效忠的说法。

entries.definition: From tributarius 'paying tribute': a stream that feeds a larger river, as if paying it; it is also an adjective meaning subject to tribute.
entries.definitionCN: 来自 tributarius「缴纳贡赋的」：向大河供水的支流，仿佛在向它进贡；也可作形容词，指需纳贡的。

entries.definition: Com- 'together' plus tribuere: to give a share toward a common result, with no suggestion of submission.
entries.definitionCN: com-「共同」加 tribuere：为共同结果出一份力，不含臣服之意。

entries.definition: Ad- 'toward' plus tribuere: to assign a cause or a quality to something, which is to allot it.
entries.definitionCN: ad-「朝向」加 tribuere：把原因或性质指派给某物，也就是把它分配过去。

entries.definition: Re- 'back' plus tribuere: a paying back, hence punishment; it shares the verb but not the meaning of tribute.
entries.definitionCN: re-「回」加 tribuere：付还，因而指报应、惩罚；共享动词，但不共享 tribute 的词义。

entries.definition: A public acknowledgment of superiority or excellence, often ceremonial; tribute can be goods as well as words.
entries.definitionCN: 公开承认优越或卓越，常为仪式性的；tribute 既可以是言语，也可以是财物。

entries.definition: A charge imposed by authority; it names the raising, while tribute names what is handed over.
entries.definitionCN: 由当局课征的费用；它指征收行为，而 tribute 指交出的东西。

entries.definition: Something presented, often to a deity or a superior; it is typically voluntary, where tribute is typically owed.
entries.definitionCN: 呈献之物，常献给神或尊长；它通常出于自愿，而 tribute 通常是所欠。

entries.definition: A formal speech of praise, especially for the dead; it is one kind of tribute in sense four.
entries.definitionCN: 正式的颂扬演说，尤指悼词；它是第四个义项中 tribute 的一种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: tribuere 'to allot' + -tum 'thing done': the share assigned and handed over.
normal.cn: tribuere「分配」+ -tum「所做之物」：被指派并交出的那一份。

normal.en: The family runs tribute, tributary, contribute, contribution, distribute, attribute, retribution.
normal.cn: 同族词有 tribute、tributary、contribute、contribution、distribute、attribute、retribution。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the senses: pay tribute to, annual tribute, a fitting tribute.
normal.cn: 固定搭配区分义项：向…致敬、年度贡赋、恰如其分的致敬。

normal.en: A river pays tribute to the sea: that is why a small stream is called a tributary.
normal.cn: 河向海进贡：这就是小水被称为支流的原因。

normal.en: The modern compound keeps the old structure: a tribute band offers imitation as homage.
normal.cn: 现代复合词保留旧结构：致敬乐队以模仿作献礼。

abstract.en: Picture a box opened at the foot of a throne, with the giver's head lower than the lid.
abstract.cn: 想象王座脚下打开的一只箱子，献者的头比箱盖还低。

abstract.en: Picture a bridge still standing after a century, quietly praising the hand that drew it.
abstract.cn: 想象一座百年后仍立着的桥，安静地称许画出它的那只手。

abstract.en: Picture miners counting out eight piles and pushing the ninth to the owner of the ground.
abstract.cn: 想象矿工数出八堆，把第九堆推到土地所有者面前。

examples.en: The empire demanded tribute in silver and in soldiers.
examples.cn: 帝国索取白银与兵员的贡赋。

examples.en: Her final book is a tribute to the teachers who doubted her.
examples.cn: 她最后一本书是向那些曾怀疑她的老师致敬。

examples.en: The miners paid tribute on every ton before they could sell the rest.
examples.cn: 矿工每吨都要先交分成，才能卖掉其余的。

dict_mnemonic.text: tribuere（分配、交出）→ 被交出的那一份；先记「王座前的木箱」，再记「以言代物的致敬」。

root: 拉丁 tribus（部族、划分单位）+ tribuere「分配、指派、支付」→ tributum「被献出之物」→ 古法语 tribut → 英语 tribute；tribus 更深来源不确定，与 tri-「三」的联系仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from a box at a throne to a band on a stage: the subject's payment, the offering of respect, the proof of worth, the ceremony of praise, exacted labour, a share of ore, an old levy, and imitation offered as homage.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从王座前的一只箱子走到舞台上的一支乐队：属国的缴纳、表敬的献礼、价值的证明、颂扬的仪式、强征的劳役、矿石分成、旧时的课征，以及以模仿示敬。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something valuable carried a long way and set down at the feet of someone stronger.
core.cn: 核心意象：贵重之物被抬了很远，放在更强者的脚下。

branches.en: WHAT IS OWED: payment in goods, payment in labour, and the older general levy are one obligation in three forms.
branches.cn: 所欠之物：以财物缴纳、以劳役缴纳、以及更早的泛称课征，是同一义务的三种形式。

branches.en: FROM DUTY TO HONOUR: an offering given under compulsion becomes a ceremony of respect freely staged.
branches.cn: 从义务到敬意：强制下的献礼变成自愿举行的致敬仪式。

branches.en: PRAISE AS PAYMENT: a lasting result is spoken of as something owed to its maker.
branches.cn: 以赞代付：长存的结果被说成欠其制作者的一笔账。

branches.en: THE GROUND'S SHARE: the same duty survives in mining, owed to a landowner rather than a state.
branches.cn: 土地的一份：同一义务在矿业留存，欠的是地主而非国家。

branches.en: IMITATION AS HOMAGE: copying a master well enough to honour him is the modern echo of carrying goods to a throne.
branches.cn: 以模仿示敬：把一位名家模仿到足以致敬，是把货物抬到王座前的现代回声。

intro.en: Tribute is the noun of a Latin verb of allotting, and that verb, not the noun, is what English borrowed again and again.
intro.cn: tribute 是一个表分配的拉丁动词的名词形式，而英语反复借入的是那个动词，不是这个名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin tribuere 'to allot' gives tribute, tributary, contribute, distribute, attribute and retribution, each with a different prefix; tribus 'tribe' is the unit behind the assigning.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 tribuere「分配」给出 tribute、tributary、contribute、distribute、attribute 与 retribution，各自带不同前缀；tribus「部族」是分配背后的单位。

items.example: Taxes were assigned through these divisions.
items.exampleCN: 税赋正是通过这些划分单位摊派的。

items.example: The verb is the engine of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是整个词族的发动机。

items.example: The participle became a noun of payment.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词成了指缴纳的名词。

items.example: English keeps the obligation tone.
items.exampleCN: 英语保留了义务的语气。

items.example: A small river is seen as paying tribute to a large one.
items.exampleCN: 小河被看作向大河进贡。

items.meaning: to give toward a common end
items.example: The prefix removes the idea of submission.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀去掉了臣服之意。

items.example: The noun is the everyday form of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是那个动词的日常形式。

items.example: The prefix spreads the allotting outward.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把分配向外铺开。

items.meaning: to assign as a cause or quality
items.example: Assigning a cause is a kind of allotting.
items.exampleCN: 归因也是一种指派。

items.example: The same verb reversed gives the opposite of a gift.
items.exampleCN: 同一个动词反向使用，给出赠礼的反面。
